class.name: SteamPurchaseBuyerInfo
class.brief_description: Steam Wallet quote metadata for a verified account.
class.description: Read through [method SteamPublisherPurchases.buyer_info] before preparing a localized quote. The purchasing status is advisory. The backend must apply its own eligibility and pricing policy.

method.name: get_account_status
method.description: Returns the Steam purchasing status, or [constant UNKNOWN] if Valve omitted it or returned a new value.

method.name: get_country
method.description: Returns the two-letter uppercase ISO 3166-1 country code.

method.name: get_currency
method.description: Returns the three-letter uppercase ISO 4217 Steam Wallet currency code.

method.name: get_region
method.description: Returns the state or region Steam supplied, or an empty string.

members.member: Purchasing status reported by Steam. Missing or unrecognized values use [constant UNKNOWN].
Two-letter uppercase ISO 3166-1 country code used to choose a local price.
Three-letter uppercase ISO 4217 Steam Wallet currency code used to quote a purchase.
State or region Steam supplied, or an empty string when unavailable.

constants.constant: Steam omitted the status or supplied a value Crimson does not recognize.
Steam reports its default purchasing status.
Steam reports an established purchase history.
Steam reports that purchasing is blocked.
